summary: Register an OAuth app via the Intuit Developer Portal to access QuickBooks Online APIs. Development apps can use sandbox immediately; production apps require Intuit's app review.
requirements: Selection of required OAuth scopes (e.g., com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting)
Agreement to Intuit API Terms of Service

steps.text: Create or sign in to an Intuit Developer account at developer.intuit.com
Create a new app in the Developer Dashboard and choose 'QuickBooks Online' as the platform
Configure OAuth 2.0 settings: add redirect URIs, select scopes, and set app type (public/private)
Provide app metadata: name, description, logo, support URL, privacy policy URL
Save the app to obtain Client ID and Client Secret
Test with sandbox credentials and a test company before submitting for production review
Submit the app for Intuit's production review if you need to go live with real user data

blockers: Production apps must pass Intuit's app review process (criteria not detailed in available sources)
